SmartCleaner 3.5.0 goes beyond Windows and browsers: Custom Cleanup can now clear the caches of your other apps, game launchers and developer tools, without touching your logins, saves or projects.

**Download SmartCleaner:** [Windows (64-bit)](https://github.com/ladroxd/SmartCleaner/releases/download/v3.5.0/SmartCleaner.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/SmartCleaner/releases/download/v3.5.0/SmartCleaner.exe.sha256)

No installer: download it and run it. Windows SmartScreen may warn that the app isn't recognised, because it isn't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## New

- **App caches.** Claude, Spotify, Notion, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, OBS Studio, the Adobe media cache and VLC.
- **Game launchers.** Steam, Epic Games, EA, Ubisoft Connect, Battle.net, GOG Galaxy and Riot Client. Steam's shader cache is cleaned in every library, on any drive.
- **Developer tools.** A new group for npm, npx, Yarn, pnpm, Bun, node-gyp, Electron, pip, Poetry, uv, Cargo, Go, NuGet, Gradle, Composer, Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf.
- **Only what you have.** Apps that aren't on your PC aren't listed, and everything new starts unticked.
- **Open apps are left alone.** An app's cache is skipped while that app is running, and the log tells you what to close.

## Changed

- **The name.** Version 3.0.0 was called OptiCore Cleaner. The app is SmartCleaner again, and your settings carry over.
- **Safer cleaning for package caches.** Some tools break if their cache is only partly deleted, so those folders are renamed in one step and then deleted. If a file inside is in use, nothing is touched. If you stop midway, the tool just makes a new cache and the next clean removes what's left.

## Fixed

- **Very long paths.** Files in paths over 260 characters are now found and deleted instead of being silently left behind.
- **Dark mode headers.** Group headers in the Custom Cleanup checklist are now readable.

## Good to know

- If you scheduled the weekly cleanup in 3.0.0, it still runs the old file. Schedule it again from `SmartCleaner.exe` to switch it over.
- Your logins, chats, saves and settings are kept. So are folders that only sound like caches, such as Poetry's virtualenvs, Maven's `.m2` and the pnpm store. The README has the full list.
- Developer caches come back on your next build or install, but that takes longer and needs internet.
- Complete Cleanup hasn't changed: these new items are only cleaned when you tick them in Custom Cleanup.
